description: Service received from an unrecorded foreign supplier: establishment unresolved, no reverse-charge decision
notes: VATCA 2010 s.12(1)(a) needs the supplier established outside the State. No one has recorded the establishment and a country code alone is not that test (EU Reg 282/2011 arts.10-11), so the rule stays unresolved and the line is flagged rather than guessed.
